## Black Goat (CR 10)

**XP** 9,600  
LE Large outsider (devil, evil, lawful)  
**Init** +2 **Senses** darkvision 90 ft., low-light vision, all-around vision, see in darkness; Perception +19  


**Defense**


**AC** 23, touch 15, flat-footed 21 (+4 deflection, +2 Dex, +8 natural, -1 size)  
**hp** 169 (13d10+39)  
**Fort** +7, **Ref** +10, **Will** +11  
**Immune** fire, poison; **Resist** acid 10, cold 10  


**Offense**


**Speed** 40 ft., fly 40 ft. (perfect)  
**Melee** +16 flaming gore (1d10+4 slashing plus 1d10 fire/profane, 19-20/x2 plus trip)  
**Special Attacks** hellfire breath weapon (30 ft. cone, 7d6 fire/profane, Ref DC 22 half, usable every 1d6 rounds)  
Witch’s Hexes—available hexes include agony, cackle, nightmares, retribution (DC 21 where applicable)  
**Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 13th concentration +21)  

Constant—mage armor, protection from good, status (upon it’s witches only)  
At Will—black tentacles, detect thoughts (Will DC 16), disguise self, fog cloud, summon (2d6 imps or accuser devils, 100%), summon swarm  
3x/day—cloudkill (Fort DC 19), deeper darkness, greater teleport (self and 50 lbs. of objects only), mind fog (Will DC 19), summon (2d4 bearded devils, 75% chance)  
1x/day—insanity (Will DC 21), irresistible dance (Will DC 22), summon (1d4+1 erinyes Devils, 60% chance)  


**Statistics**


**Str** 18, **Dex** 15, **Con** 16, **Int** 19, **Wis** 17, **Cha** 21  
**Base Atk** +13; **CMB** +18 (+20 trip); **CMD** 30  
**Feats** Ability Focus (hellfire breath weapon) Augment Summoning, Combat Casting, [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md), Improved Trip, [Weapon Focus (gore)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md)  
*House rules: Dodge and Mobility are one feat, Dodgility; in their place: Weapon Focus (gore).*  
**Skills** Bluff +21, Diplomacy +21, Knowledge (arcana, religion, local) +20, Intimidate +21, Perform (dance) +21, Perception +19, Sense Motive +19  
**Languages** Abyssal, Celestial, Common, Infernal, truespeech  


**Special Abilities**


**Hellfire (Su)** Half the energy damage inflicted by the Black Goat’s breath weapon and flaming gore attack is fire, and the other half is profane damage, not subject to energy resistance or immunity.  

**Hexes (Su)** The Black Goat can use a variety of hexes, as a 13th-level witch.  

**Master Familiar (Su)** A Black Goat can simultaneously act as a patron for up to 13 individual Witches, all of whom must have evil alignments. Typically, the Black Goat establishes a central meeting place where all members of its coven commune with it for several hours to prepare their spells, or lives among its Witches as a king among his harem.
